articles.title: Live updates: Crypto gives up more ground as AI selloff picks up steam
articles.snippet: A Friday surge in oil prices is hitting already-shaky equity markets, sending the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange already paid up, but a court order and restrictions from its 2025 settlement will not be lifted even though the CFTC said the case should have never been presented.

articles.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.

articles.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

articles.title: Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
articles.snippet: Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.
